title: Silas and the Scholarship
author: Edmund Lockridge
blurb: Beatrix Okafor, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
